assets.prompt: Create an extremely abstract minimalist geometric artwork for a translucent personal portfolio website, loosely distilled from the supplied architectural photographs. CRITICAL: the previous attempt was far too literal. Do NOT depict a building, recognizable complete facade, realistic architecture, photograph, floor, walls, city, people, or realistic material texture. Instead make a very sparse 2.5D composition of a FEW floating translucent geometric planes and fine structural lines. Think a museum-quality abstract glass relief / sophisticated geometric visual identity, with 85% of photographic detail removed. This is one of four assets sharing identical art direction: vapor-thin frosted glass, delicate pale edges, very low contrast, daylight, almost colorless transparent surfaces, restrained geometric rigor. Actual TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha, no white rectangular canvas, no ground plane, no cast ground shadows. Wide landscape 16:9 image. Arrange the entire abstract construction in the right 65% and upper half, leave leftmost 35% and lower quarter genuinely transparent. Object should be airy, fragmentary, softly dissolve at its outer and lower edges. No text, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative balls, generic blobs, neon, heavy opaque blocks or strong dark areas. All geometry must be visibly translucent, with overlapping planes barely tinting one another. Small colored accents also translucent. Do not use realism. KYOTO STATION distilled into geometry ONLY: a cropped sweeping lattice vault made from about 12 widely spaced silver-blue linear ribs and a few cross braces, receding gently toward an off-center vanishing point at the right. One slender diagonal bridge-like line and two broad almost invisible glass planes. NO dense grid, NO actual station interior, NO floor, NO walls. The structure is an incomplete floating grid fragment, geometric and high-tech, sparsely drawn. Cool pearl, faint ice blue #b8cedb, silver #c7d0d7; maximum accent strength is pale blue-gray. The ribs must be extremely light, fine and translucent, no opaque dark steel. Mostly empty space.
